Would love to set up a 30 min demo to walk through how our Dedicated and Private deployment options can support HIPAA workloads and your throughput goals.

- Primary use case (chat, clinical summarization, embeddings + search, reranking)?
- Typical request volume: avg qps and peak qps (you mentioned ~150 rps peak — is that requests/sec or tokens/sec?)

- Any compliance constraints beyond HIPAA (BAA already in place, SOC2 requirements, on-premise-only)?
- Who else should join from your side (platform, security, data)?

A couple of proposed slots next week: Tue Apr 21 9:30–10:00am PT, Wed Apr 22 10:00–10:30am PT, Thu Apr 23 11:00–11:30am PT. Or grab a time here: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Happy to answer:
- Use case: embeddings + semantic search for clinical notes and a small set of summarization tasks for care coordinators.
- Volume: ~15 qps average during the day, expected peaks up to ~150 requests/sec during batch ingestion windows (roughly 15–30 min bursts). For generation tasks token counts vary but average 400–600 tokens per request.
- Timeline: pilot in May, production targeted for end of Q3.
- Compliance: HIPAA mandatory; we need a BAA and prefer SOC2 Type II evidence. Likely to evaluate Private deployment but want to understand tradeoffs and cost.
- Attendees: me (Head of Platform), plus our security lead Maya Chopra (cc later).

Any chance to get a ballpark on pricing for Dedicated vs Private for throughput like this? If not, the demo is fine for now. I can do Wed Apr 22 10am PT.

Best,
Alex
